synthetic_work.title: 월요일의 천문대
synthetic_work.source_cutoff: Synthetic current state through EP04 only. No EP05 answer key exists.
synthetic_work.premise: A municipal hilltop observatory, a nearby middle school, and several families share the same neighborhood but face separate pressures involving public funding, caregiving, career choices, accessibility, memory, and professional identity. The episode must allow intersections without treating every conflict as a consequence of the observatory's budget.

series_anchors.immutable_premise: The observatory is a social crossroads, not a master cause. Independent family, school, career, volunteer, and historical-memory conflicts must retain their own causal roots.
series_anchors.tone: ensemble workplace/family drama with restrained humor, social texture, indirect emotion, and visible physical behavior
forbidden_shortcut: Do not make all strands consequences of the municipal funding review.
Do not solve private family conflict through one public astronomy event.
Do not force every supporting-character strand into Haejin's decision.
Do not convert open historical evidence into a fully verified public truth without source support.

YOON_HAEJIN.public_goal: keep the public program credible during the municipal review
YOON_HAEJIN.private_goal: avoid using her niece Eunseo as proof that the observatory serves schools
YOON_HAEJIN.fear: turning family care into institutional leverage
YOON_HAEJIN.withheld: has not told staff that the city offered her a temporary administrative post if programs are cut

SEO_MINWOO.private_goal: decide whether to accept a private planetarium job
SEO_MINWOO.fear: staying only because others expect him to be indispensable
SEO_MINWOO.withheld: a private planetarium asked for a decision by tomorrow noon

KIM_BORA.public_goal: repair the spectrograph before the school visit
KIM_BORA.private_goal: submit an overseas fellowship application without asking Minwoo for a recommendation
KIM_BORA.fear: being treated as an apprentice forever
KIM_BORA.withheld: the fellowship application closes at 18:30 today

PARK_DONGSIK.private_goal: secure written recognition for years of unpaid accessibility escort work
PARK_DONGSIK.fear: the institution will praise volunteers while erasing their labor

CHOI_EUNSEO.role: Haejin's teenage niece and science-club leader
CHOI_EUNSEO.private_goal: set a boundary against being treated as Haejin's responsibility project
CHOI_EUNSEO.fear: her mother's absence becoming a reason adults make choices for her

LEE_SORA.role: wheelchair user and neighborhood accessibility organizer
LEE_SORA.public_goal: make the observatory's winter program physically accessible
LEE_SORA.private_goal: stop accepting symbolic invitations without operational changes
LEE_SORA.fear: being used as a publicity image

HAN_JAEHO.public_goal: keep the school club visit scheduled
HAN_JAEHO.private_goal: admit he altered the club roster to protect one student from a disciplinary record
HAN_JAEHO.fear: losing institutional trust if the alteration becomes known

relationship_state.pressure: Haejin acts as guardian in practice; Eunseo resists being managed
Haejin assumes Minwoo will stay through winter; he is considering leaving
Bora wants independence and has not asked for a recommendation
both want accessibility work recognized but disagree about public confrontation
Eunseo knows the club roster was quietly changed but not why

information_state.fact: Bora's fellowship application closes at 18:30 today.
A private planetarium offered Minwoo a job; answer due tomorrow noon.
Jaeho altered the science-club roster to protect a student from a disciplinary mark.
An old maintenance log appears to show the observatory once budgeted for paid accessibility escorts, but the page is incomplete and unauthenticated.

obligation_portfolio.causal_root: municipal review cycle scheduled months earlier
obligation_portfolio.statement: The observatory must choose what program scope it will formally defend at today's municipal review meeting.
obligation_portfolio.protected_delta: A concrete operating stance must be chosen; continued full funding is not required.
obligation_portfolio.visible_action: Haejin removes two program cards from the presentation board, then restores one after Minwoo refuses to sign the reduced schedule.

obligation_portfolio.causal_root: years of informal caregiving after Eunseo's mother began working abroad
obligation_portfolio.statement: Haejin and Eunseo must establish a new explicit boundary about decisions Haejin may make on Eunseo's behalf.
obligation_portfolio.protected_delta: Relationship state changes without requiring reconciliation or family harmony.
obligation_portfolio.visible_action: Eunseo takes the emergency-contact form from Haejin's folder, crosses out Haejin's prewritten answer, and writes her own.

obligation_portfolio.statement: Bora's fellowship deadline must become behaviorally consequential before 18:30.
obligation_portfolio.protected_delta: At least one work decision changes because Bora may leave or needs time to apply.
obligation_portfolio.visible_action: Bora sets a laptop beside the open spectrograph, starts the application timer, and refuses Minwoo's request to stay through the evening repair.

obligation_portfolio.causal_root: years of unpaid accessibility escort work predating the current review
obligation_portfolio.statement: Accessibility labor must be treated as an institutional operating cost and claim, not as sentimental volunteer goodwill.
obligation_portfolio.protected_delta: The operating plan changes in response to accessibility labor claims.
obligation_portfolio.visible_action: Sora wheels past the ceremonial ribbon and places a typed escort-shift cost sheet over the photo-op schedule.

obligation_portfolio.causal_root: a regional cloud front independently cancels the booked mobile telescope demonstration
obligation_portfolio.statement: The school club loses its planned mobile telescope demonstration less than two hours before the visit.
obligation_portfolio.protected_delta: The club must make a replacement public-learning decision that exposes character priorities.
obligation_portfolio.visible_action: Jaeho folds the printed rooftop route map while Eunseo erases the telescope icon from the club board and leaves the time slot blank.

obligation_portfolio.causal_root: a maintenance archive found during an unrelated storeroom inventory in EP04
obligation_portfolio.statement: The incomplete old accessibility-pay log must affect today's choices but cannot yet be authenticated or publicly resolved.
obligation_portfolio.protected_delta: The log is touched and changes at least one private stance while remaining OPEN.
obligation_portfolio.visible_action: Dongsik slips the torn log page under Sora's cost sheet, but keeps the missing signature column covered with his hand.

obligation_portfolio.causal_root: Minwoo's private job offer and long-standing fear of becoming professionally static
obligation_portfolio.statement: Minwoo must make a costly choice that reveals whether he values institutional continuity or his own next step more.
obligation_portfolio.protected_delta: The choice incurs a concrete cost and cannot be a simple heroic pledge.
obligation_portfolio.visible_action: Minwoo signs the municipal schedule only after removing his own name from the winter lecture roster.
